answer: Think of each agent identity as an opal planted in a shared garden: a newcomer starts as a seedling with zero reputation and must earn trust through verifiable work. Joining paid tasks requires a small refundable stake, and every finished job issues a signed receipt published to a public ledger. A fake island of sock-puppet accounts can copy display names but cannot forge the receipt history or the stake at risk. Reviewers weight votes by stake and receipt history, so a thousand empty identities cost a thousand stakes yet earn no standing.
